mapper.sql: select p.id, p.partner_name as partnerName, p.logo_file_id as logoFileId, lf.access_url as logoUrl, p.website_url as websiteUrl, p.partner_type as partnerType, p.cooperation_start_date as cooperationStartDate, p.cooperation_end_date as cooperationEndDate, p.partner_status as partnerStatus, p.sort_no as sortNo, p.remark, p.create_time as createTime, p.update_time as updateTime from basket_partner p left join basket_file_asset lf on lf.id = p.logo_file_id and lf.is_delete = 0
mapper.select: select id, partner_name, logo_file_id, website_url, partner_type, cooperation_start_date, cooperation_end_date, partner_status, sort_no, remark, create_time, update_time, is_delete from basket_partner where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0
mapper.update:

partner_name = #{partnerName}, logo_file_id = #{logoFileId}, website_url = #{websiteUrl}, partner_type = #{partnerType}, cooperation_start_date = #{cooperationStartDate}, cooperation_end_date = #{cooperationEndDate}, sort_no = #{sortNo}, remark = #{remark}, partner_status = #{partnerStatus}, update_time = now()
